response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which at priority 90 allows return regardless of the standard 30-day window. Although RET-008 (out of window at 44 days) applies at priority 10, the defective rule dominates. RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is False, and no fraud hold or goodwill grant is present.
